title: Camera Authority and Emergency Runtime Continuity
summary: Completes exact camera connection, stream identity and authenticated preview authority, and reconstructs stable runtime continuity for install, update, restart, maintenance and recovery across supported NAS environments.
changelog: Adds first-class nullable ONVIF Sub-profile identity and exact Main/Sub selection, testing and persistence without changing manual RTSP cameras.
Separates camera management and RTSP authority, preserves explicit ports, and serves preview frames only through authenticated product access.
Adds an inventory-bound stable bootstrap and verified release-slot authority for clean install, update, restart and recovery.
Makes persistent services restart automatically while one-shot schema, bootstrap and restore jobs remain non-persistent and writer-fenced.
Removes legacy-root runtime fallback, adds bounded one-time adoption, and converges terminal update recovery to the exact target or previous slot.
Restores Maintenance with sanitized update-check presentation and hardens canonical restart, storage apply, migration and manual-update entry points.
Adds targeted camera, schema, restart, update and Maintenance regressions, including the real TerraMaster ordinary-SSH PATH boundary.
